statement: For every 99-by-99 symmetric binary zero-diagonal matrix A with exactly 14 ones in each integer row, put r_uv=(A^2)_uv+A_uv-2 for u<v and let F3 count all unordered residuals not divisible by 3. Then F3 is not 4. Together with C-UNRESTRICTED-DEGREE14-TERNARY-SMALL-DEFECT-SUPPORT r1, this gives F3=0 or F3>=6. No realization of any allowed value and no target existence or nonexistence conclusion is asserted.

scope.description: Universal necessary exclusion of the single ternary residual count F3=4 in the complete simple symmetric zero-diagonal degree14 adjacency domain of order99. No lambda1, incidence, fixed graph, prism, automorphism or numerical premise.

assumptions: A has order99, symmetric binary entries and zero diagonal.
Every integer row has exactly14 ones; all common-neighbor and residual row sums use the complete matrix.
F3 counts all4851 unordered pairs with identical endpoint residues.
The pinned small-support theorem r1 supplies only the necessary alternating C4 support shape when F3=4.

recorded_validation.combined_necessary_residual_domain: F3=0 or F3>=6, using the exact prior small-support theorem r1; no allowed value asserted realizable.
